title: FORM COMPLETION PRACTICE & TIPS
description: Learn to complete forms accurately while listening to conversations.
transcript: Good morning, I'd like to register for the conference. My name is Jennifer Smith, that's J-E-N-N-I-F-E-R S-M-I-T-H. I'm from the University of Cambridge, and my email address is j.smith@cam.ac.uk. I'll be staying at the Grand Hotel for three nights, from March 15th to March 18th. I'm particularly interested in the session on environmental science.

title: Hotel Booking: Form Completion
description: Practice completing hotel booking forms with listening comprehension.
transcript: Hello, I'd like to make a reservation for next week. My name is Michael Johnson, M-I-C-H-A-E-L J-O-H-N-S-O-N. I need a room for two adults and one child. We'll be arriving on Tuesday, June 10th, and departing on Friday, June 13th. I'd prefer a room with a sea view if possible. My contact number is 07789 123456, and my email is m.johnson@email.com. I have a special dietary requirement - vegetarian meals.

title: University Application: Form Completion
description: Practice completing university application forms with detailed information.
transcript: Good afternoon, I'm calling about my university application. My full name is Sarah Elizabeth Thompson, that's S-A-R-A-H E-L-I-Z-A-B-E-T-H T-H-O-M-P-S-O-N. I'm applying for the Master's program in Environmental Science. I completed my undergraduate degree at Oxford University with a first-class honors in Biology. My student ID number is 2023-ES-7894. I'm particularly interested in climate change research and would like to work with Professor Johnson. My preferred start date is September 2024, and I'm applying for the scholarship program as well.

title: Job Application: Form Completion
description: Practice completing job application forms with professional information.
transcript: Hello, I'm interested in the Marketing Manager position advertised on your website. My name is David Chen, D-A-V-I-D C-H-E-N. I have over five years of experience in digital marketing, currently working at Tech Solutions Ltd. I have a Bachelor's degree in Business Administration from London Business School. My current salary is £45,000 per annum, and I'm looking for a salary range of £50,000 to £55,000. I'm available to start immediately and can work flexible hours. My reference is my current manager, Ms. Sarah Williams, and her contact number is 020 7123 4567.
